description: This file contains utility functions for line matching, stream processing, and diffing, specifically for handling chat message streams and line comparisons.

methods.name: linesMatchPerfectly
methods.description: Checks if two lines are exactly the same and not empty.

methods.name: linesMatch
methods.description: Determines if two lines match, considering fuzzy matching with edit distance and special cases.

methods.name: matchLine
methods.description: Finds a matching line in old lines for a new line, considering indentation and special line types.

methods.name: streamLines
methods.description: Converts an async stream of chunks or chat messages into a stream of lines.

methods.name: generateLines
methods.description: Generates lines asynchronously from an array of lines.
